summary: Project to deploy an app with signup/login that should not require Internet Identity.

existing_features.title: Remove all Internet Identity-gated signup/login flows so the core app pages can be used without any signup or login. Specifically, anonymous users must be able to access and use the main routes (ReportEntryPage, ReportHistoryPage, ReportDetailPage) without being redirected to or blocked by LoginScreen, ProfileSetup, or SignupPendingAccessScreen.

Ensure admin-only routes remain protected from anonymous access (e.g., /admin/users). Anonymous users attempting to access admin routes must see an access denied screen and must not be prompted to log in with Internet Identity.

Apply a coherent, consistent visual theme across the updated anonymous-mode screens and navigation (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) aligned with an industrial/service-reporting app aesthetic, avoiding blue/purple as primary brand colors.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove Internet Identity requirement from signup/login (do not use Internet Identity authentication).

Update the app header/navigation to behave correctly in anonymous mode by hiding identity-dependent UI. Specifically: do not show the user name block when no profile is available; hide/remove the "Sign Out" action for anonymous users; keep admin navigation hidden unless admin status is positively confirmed, and ensure anonymous users never see admin navigation.

projectName: Remove Internet Identity requirement and run app in anonymous mode
